thesis: The speakers argue that the internet faces an unsolved problem of distinguishing unique humans from AI agents that can now pass the Turing test and run thousands of social media accounts. They explain that previous solutions like web-of-trust graphs, government IDs, and biometrics are insufficient because AI can mimic human behavior, government systems lack global scalability and anonymity, and biometrics fail to solve the fundamental need for one-to-many uniqueness verification.
